_description: refillTrigger='always' refills bucket from any year's surplus, even in down markets — verifies the trigger fires regardless of stockFactor.
_rationale: Small starting cash $5k + Pension $100k income + Spending $20k. Net surplus ≈ $80k − tax. Policy min=12, target=24, max=36 (months of $20k = monthly ≈ $1667). With deterministic stockReturn=0% and a black-swan event year 0 (stock×0.5), 'always' MUST refill anyway (gains_only would NOT, demonstrating the contrast). monthly = $20k/12 ≈ $1,667. target = 24 × $1,667 ≈ $40k. Cash $5k below min 12×$1,667 = $20k → refill triggers. Surplus is large (~$80k) — refill takes min(target-cashBal, surplus) = $40k - $5k = $35k. cashEndingBalance ≈ $40k.
name: Bucket Always Refill
